entry.name: array.routepass
entry.digest: Route a complete input array object based on input matching
entry.description: Like routepass, but for array objects.

arguments.name: match keys
arguments.description: Determines the number of outlets. The object will route arrays to the associated outlet if the first element of the array matches the argument key. Unmatched arrays are routed through the rightmost outlet. The special keysandmatch the empty string and empty array, and the keymatches the empty symbol.
